name: Mandatory Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
description: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the package in the form 'Maximum or Max. retail price... incl. of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs... incl. of all taxes'.

name: Net Quantity Declaration and Standard Unit
legal_reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6(1)(c) read with Rule 13
description: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure or number shall be declared on every package.

name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Pre-packing
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned.

name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer
description: The name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer, including city, state and PIN code, shall be declared.

name: Consumer Care Email Address
description: The email address of the person or office that can be contacted in case of consumer complaints must be declared.

name: Consumer Care Telephone Number
description: Telephone / Toll-free helpline number for consumer complaints must be clearly declared on the package.

name: Generic Commodity / Product Name
description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

name: Country of Origin for Imported Commodities
description: For packages containing imported commodities, the name and address of the importer and Country of Origin must be mentioned.
